entry.title: Liminal Amp 1.1.0
entry.summary: # Liminal Amp 1.1.0 **Ready for MPC OS 3.10.1.** MPC OS 3.10.1 opened the MPC to third-party plugins officially: copy a plugin folder into a `VST2 Plugins` folder on any drive, flip one switch, done. entry.title: Liminal Amp 1.0.2
entry.summary: # Liminal Amp 1.0.2 Gen 1 gets the same fast cab as Gen 2. ## Changes - **Faster cab IR on Gen 1.** The Force / MPC Live / Live II / One / X / Key 61 build now runs the cabinet IR's FFT with NEON, as the Gen 2 build already did. Until now the Gen 1 build used slower plain (scalar) code for it. The sound doesn't change: the IR is still processed to the official NAM plugin's spec (up to 8192 samples, its resampling and level), checked against the official convolution on 32-bit ARM. entry.title: Liminal Amp 1.0.1
entry.summary: # Liminal Amp 1.0.1 A small update to [1.0.0](../v1.0.0): smoother taps, and a measured CPU figure for the MPC OS Plugin Catalog. ## Changes - **Smoother phone-page taps.** GET TONES, BROWSE TONE3000 and NAME ON PHONE now start the phone page's server in the plugin's background thread. The first tap used to do that work on the spot (a few milliseconds), which the catalog's CPU bench counted as an overrun.
